en.description: An open-source backend for apps: a database API, users, files, cloud code and push, with Parse Dashboard
en.notes: The dashboard is at https://{host}: sign in as admin with the admin password you gave. Apps use https://{host}/parse as the server URL, with the APP_ID from the project’s .env; the MASTER_KEY there is for servers only. MongoDB is part of the project.

de.description: Ein Open-Source-Backend für Apps: Datenbank-API, Benutzer, Dateien, Cloud Code und Push, mit dem Parse Dashboard
